title: Interior translation (difference) estimate for W^{1,2}(B)
statement: Let n >= 1 and IsW12WithGradient f g B, with B the open unit ball of R^n. For every r > 0 and every z in R^n with |z| < 1 - r: int_{B_r} |f(x - z) - f(x)|^2 dx <= |z|^2 int_B |g|^2. Here B_r := ball(0,r), the integrals are lintegrals, and the right side is ENNReal.ofReal(|z|^2) times the energy.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ (r : ℝ) (z : Rn n), 0 < r → ‖z‖ < 1 - r → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f (x - z) - f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (‖z‖ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
